name: Sunday No Drop Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 9:30 am from the John Jones parking lot in Davis (9:00 am in summer). Rain or heat can cancel.

pace: 14 mph and up; riders at 14-16 and at 18-22 both ride it
visitor_notes: Guests can ride once; after that the club asks you to join. Helmet required. Arrive about five minutes early, the group rolls on time. A sweeper rides at the back.

name: Saturday Joy Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 10:00 am from the Westlake Plaza parking lot (9:00 am April to mid-September). Rain or wind over 12 mph cancels; the leader may cancel when few riders sign up.
visitor_notes: Contact the ride leader before you come, because the ride can be cancelled without notice when attendance is thin. Guests can ride once, then the club asks you to join. Helmet required.
description: The Davis Bike Club's slow Saturday ride. Nobody is dropped, there are regular catch-up spots, and the route changes with who shows up. The club pitches it at people recovering from an injury or getting back on a bike.
